svg.text: Each trial consists of 3 sequential LSTM steps: Stimulus → Decision → Feedback
Hidden state (h, c) is passed between all steps and persists across trials within a block
Output discarded (no action at stim step)
Output discarded (no action at fb step)
Only hidden state updated with reward info
hidden₃ → next trial's hidden (persists within block)
At the start of each new block: hidden = None (reset). New reward probabilities sampled.
2 of 3 identities kept, 1 dropped, 1 new identity introduced.
